title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: automatic .NET runtime acquisition on AL Language Extension.
summary: The AL Language extension now automatically downloads and installs .NET 10.0 runtime on startup instead of bundling platform-specific binaries. This reduces extension size from 500MB to under 25MB and simplifies maintenance, but creates a workaround issue with BCContainerHelper that requires users to manually install .NET 10 beforehand.
key_points: AL Language extension uses automatic .NET Install Tool for .NET 10.0 runtime acquisition
Extension size dramatically reduced by eliminating bundled platform-specific runtime packages
Fallback mechanism to existing ASP.NET Core runtime provides graceful degradation on download failure
BCContainerHelper's auto-download logic is broken with new .NET 10 requirement, requiring manual .NET 10 installation
Windows, Linux, and macOS users should pre-install .NET 10 to avoid BCContainerHelper build failures

quotes.text: The latest release of the AL Language extension switches to automatic .NET runtime acquisition via the .NET Install Tool for VS Code.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core change affecting how the extension manages runtime dependencies
